# SugarCRM | Product Overview

SugarCRM is a sales, marketing and service platform for medium-sized and large B2B enterprises, with emphasis on configuration processes, forecasting and deployment controls. The product core builds a unified workspace around customer relations, sales implementation and revenue processes, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
